valid_trace_derivation.action_trace: Initial inspect +31 accepted inspect actions +first finalize uses33 of128 actions and requests32 images. Completion additionally requires all common byte/time reservations and provider HTTP limits; this is not an observed live episode.
valid_trace_derivation.cap_vs_reachability: Each accepted compressed PNG<=4MiB is a configured safety bound, not a proven attainable maximum of the constrained renderer. Therefore32*4MiB is not a reachable complete-wire claim: headers and the conservative next-image reservation can exhaust the128MiB common byte ceiling first. No actual cohort encoding lengths were read or measured. Both arms retain identical available viewer limits; none is reduced here.
valid_trace_derivation.encoding_policy: Existing transfer_png.encode_transport_image at level9 plus bounded scanline identity verification; operator event stores the existing descriptor, participant metadata is unchanged. Saved captures are audited by pixel identity and descriptor rather than requiring re-encoding byte identity across zlib versions.
valid_trace_derivation.exact_retained_image_formula: For one complete query with M<=32 accepted images of compressed sizes L_j: viewer plus transport image bytes=2*sum_j L_j. For6400 queries, sum this exact quantity across all complete query traces; no image is discarded or subset selected.
valid_trace_derivation.http_history_formula: For T<=127 provider requests, total image base64 characters=sum_k sum_{j visible by request k}4*ceil(transfer_png_bytes_j/3), plus repeated text/JSON. If all32 images arrive as early as allowed and T=127,3568 image occurrences appear across saved complete histories.
valid_trace_derivation.http_qualification: The8MiB per-request history ceiling and cumulative HTTP caps may stop the provider before common viewer action/image limits, depending actual lossless sizes and decisions. No remote capacity or equal-throughput claim is established. Histories remain complete; no truncation or content reference is credited.
valid_trace_derivation.programme_reservation: Only the next episode plus closeout is reserved before each dispatch. The all6400 sum is a conservative ceiling, not startup precharge or an admission barrier; measured compressed consumption controls remaining capacity.
valid_trace_derivation.raw_raster_formula: S=820*(1+1400*3)=3444820; raw stored-DEFLATE PNG=S+5*ceil(S/65535)+6+57=3445148. This is the pre-compression raster, not new full32 retained bytes.
valid_trace_derivation.wire_formula: Outbound bytes=sum_j L_j +sum_k encoded_header_bytes_k +8*K, K<=128; completion requires this within max_output_bytes and each render preflight reserves PNG_MAX+HEADER_MAX+RESERVE.

future_capture_accounting.compressed_retention: Both new full32 arms save and deliver existing lossless compressed PNGs. Exact retained lengths depend on the trace; each accepted frame remains bounded by4MiB. Legacy raw PNG output is unchanged.
future_capture_accounting.interpretation: The6400-case sum is a conservative all-case maximum, not an upfront admission requirement. Existing run_programme reserves only the next episode plus closeout against measured_bytes, reconciles once with final inventory, and may complete measured compressed traces under the existing cap. Worst-case complete6400 success remains unpromised; no cap/action/cohort reduction or increase is selected.

future_live_parameter_roster.selection: No live parameter set selected here. Existing lower settings are configurable only if identically frozen across paired arms; no reduction is chosen by this source phase.

future_time.evaluation: Independent complete saved-evidence validation requires its own selected time/read/RAM/ownership envelope. No duration is extrapolated from generated controls or two prior numerical canaries.
future_time.interpretation: The sum is a mathematical window bound, not a throughput prediction. Existing finite campaign exhaustion preserves partial failure evidence and prohibits complete-arm admission. No arbitrary subset or retry is substituted.

resource_formulas.future_ram: No live candidate/provider RAM qualification is selected. Viewer/capture admission processes one query/record at a time, but full request histories, JSON, codec copies, source modules and candidate memory require a separately declared owned envelope. The1GiB limit here applies only to the generated source campaign.

scaling.actual_measured_file_admission: Existing full32 Budget is shared explicitly through packet, viewer, transport, provider, programme and matching readers. Each bounded opened file reserves fstat extent+1 before reading exactly that extent+1; query spans reserve their exact declared bytes. Exhaustion refuses before the body read. The counter includes repeated validation and failed-pin reads; it is logical application-read accounting, not a physical disk-I/O meter. No read-once custody seal is claimed.

evaluation_parameters.deleted_npz_snapshot_write_accounting: Each of two <=1MiB snapshots precharges the shared write counter before creation; deleted bytes remain charged. Together with bounded result/failure, they fit the unchanged4MiB minimum.
evaluation_parameters.npz: bounded existing ZIP/NPY validation/materialization reserves in addition to capture reads
evaluation_parameters.private_metadata: named16MiB reserve before existing protected loader, after both complete arms and matching
evaluation_parameters.read_bytes: positive finite integer, at most2**63-1; shared operation-wide logical counter
evaluation_parameters.work_seconds: positive finite, at most86400; separately selected whole evaluation limit
evaluation_parameters.write_bytes: positive finite integer, at least4MiB and at most2**63-1; durable output allocation

scaling.inventory: One streaming metadata-only capture inventory per retained arm, bounded by6400*(32+20*max_actions) entries and selected read_bytes as observed-retention ceiling. Maximum stack8 explicit directory fds plus8 iterators (which may duplicate OS descriptors). This inventory never substitutes for byte/hash custody; depth, entry and byte overflow refuse.
scaling.remaining_independent_revalidation: Final admission must authenticate retained mutable captures independently of execution-time audits; previous receipt success alone is not a seal. Initial-header matching still rereads exact authenticated frames.
scaling.removed: Growing whole-programme-output tree scans inside every query and repeated provider-prefix byte sums. New-episode extents and incremental counters reconcile once with final inventory/totals.
scaling.startup_reservation_status: Exact frozen source/runtime descriptor extents are supplied by the later selected contract. This phase does not invent their values or fund a future evaluation. Per-episode source reads also need the shared counter; fixed overhead is not permission to bypass it.
scaling.unavoidable_retention: Exact HTTP request history includes previous images by protocol; replacing it with a reference is a different future capture-format contract.

qualification_limits: Generated compression does not fund or predict actual6400 retention, throughput or provider capacity.
One next episode plus closeout is reserved against measured retained bytes; the summed all-case maximum is not an upfront admission requirement.
No cap increase, cohort reduction, retry, truncation or history deduplication is selected.
Live macOS interpreter/allowlist compatibility, provider image/context behavior, actual material/custody and full operation resources remain separately selectable.
